findings.title: getSubGroupsCount can now return null for a deleted group
findings.body: When the group is deleted concurrently, `modelSupplier.get()` returns null and `getSubGroupsCount()` now returns null instead of throwing an NPE. The method's callers do not expect that. `GroupUtils.populateSubGroupCount` passes the result straight to `representation.setSubGroupCount(...)`. The `getSubGroupsStream(...)` overloads at lines 256, 262 and 268 still call `modelSupplier.get()` and dereference it directly, so they can still throw NPE under the same race. The fix is incomplete.

findings.title: Reader thread is not joined, so the test is flaky and can leak the thread
findings.body: The background reader thread is started but never joined. The assertion on `caughtExceptions` can run while the thread is still mid-request. Exceptions thrown after the assertion are missed, and the thread can keep calling the server after the test finishes and the realm is cleaned up. The thread should be joined after `deletedAll.set(true)`, before asserting. The loop also hammers the server with no pause.
